rulings.raw: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts ((See Note 1))
rulings.evidence: The vocabulary row IS Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast [chicken-breast]; the DIFFERENT FORM flag is only the plural 'breasts'. Board carries chicken-breast 7 of 7.
The `spinach` id is the fresh bagged leaf (frozen has its own id, frozen-chopped-spinach), so 'fresh' is not a flip here; board 7 of 7.

Grape and cherry are the same pint clamshell of small tomatoes at the same price class; the standing rejection is against bridging either onto bulk `tomatoes`, and the board's `grapes` match is fruit, a keyword miss.
black-olives is a live board id (6 of 7) - a reuse; green olives are a different brine product at a different price. Weight is the line's own stated drained basis.
Live board id at 5 of 7, the same reuse as the Jamie Oliver line; 2 medium lemons at 58 g.
The ground-cloves near-miss is a keyword collision on the word 'cloves'; this is fresh bulb garlic, board 6 of 7, at the DB's 3 g per clove.
